title: Lighting
modeHint: Switch between effect settings and device placement
subEffect: Pick an effect in the library below and tune the one playing.
subLayout: Drag, resize and rotate your devices over the effect.
speedHint: How fast the effect moves (100% = normal)
savePresetHint: Save the current settings as a preset
resetText: Reset all settings of this effect to their defaults?
unsavedText: Switching layouts discards unsaved changes. Continue?
autoArrangeText: Reposition all visible items without overlap?
noDevices: No active devices. See the Devices tab.
keyDo.copy: Copy / paste scale, rotation, flip and brightness
layoutHelp: Click a device in the preview or in the list to place it. Drag to move, use the square handle to resize and the round handle to rotate.
lofiOnScreen: Screen Ambience is on: the LEDs are following what is on your screen. Meanwhile, a little scene to keep you company.
lofiOnSound: Screen Ambience is on: the LEDs are following your PC sound. Meanwhile, a little scene to keep you company.
presetsHint: Saves this effect's current settings under a name (e.g. "Calm purple") so you can come back to them later with one click.
shapeHint: Lay the strip out the way it is mounted in the case: as a U, a zigzag, around anything you like.
shapeEditing: Drag the light end (head) or the other end (tail): it moves in a straight line, on a rail, and only turns when you really move away from the line, making a clean L corner. Shift locks the direction, Alt draws freehand. Ended up with an accidental bend? Use the Ruler (R). While shaping, the strip stays in place; to move it, click Done.
rulerWhat: Pick two LEDs: everything between them becomes a straight line. The rest of the strip keeps its shape and just follows.
rulerHow1: Click the LED right before the crooked bend.
rulerHow2: Move the mouse to the LED right after it, check the preview and click (or drag from one LED to the other).
rulerNote: Nothing changes before the second click. Esc cancels the start; Ctrl+Z undoes.
rulerStep1: Ruler · 1/2: click the LED right BEFORE the crooked bend
rulerStep2: Ruler · 2/2: click the LED right AFTER the bend (Esc cancels)
shapeOverlap: Heads up: the strip now passes through the same spot twice. Ctrl+Z undoes.
